verification.what_it_means: Google wants to confirm who pays for and runs the ads. Missing the deadline can restrict ads or pause the account until it is done.
collect: The legal name of the business exactly as it appears on the Google Ads payments profile
A business registration or state licence document that shows that name and the business address
The name and ID of the person who will complete verification for the business
The mortgage broker licence for each state the ads target (Colorado, Arizona, Utah), in case Google asks for industry details
steps: Open the verification request from the banner in Google Ads.
Check the legal name on the payments profile matches the document before you upload it.
Submit before November 20, 2026; there are 21 days left.
